description: Supplemental attribute defining which existing generators mapped to a supply technology are eligible for retirement, optionally with the year each was built and the year each is already scheduled to retire.

eligible_generators.description: Names of individual generation units mapped to a technology that are eligible for retirement.

planned_retirement_year.description: Optional dictionary to indicate the year in which the forced/planned retirement will occur.

build_year.description: Optional dictionary to indicate the year in which existing generators in the base system were built.

title: RetirementPotential
